column1: # Any rule not listed here keeps ZAP's default baseline behaviour (WARN),
# 90004-3 (COOP) is the one rule this project promotes to FAIL — it's exactly
# what Spec S00 exists to prove (see ADR-S00-02), and it's a real regression
# gate: passes today because vite.config.ts's `preview.headers` mirrors the
# real public/_headers Cloudflare config, and it's what the PR canhoto will
# strip to prove this gate bites.
# 90004-2 (COEP) is deliberately NOT promoted, even though this app also sets
# a COEP header: ZAP's own rule implementation only recognizes `require-corp`
# as a valid COEP value and flags `credentialless` as "missing or invalid" —
# a confirmed upstream bug (zaproxy/zaproxy#8840), not a defect in this app.
# `credentialless` is this project's deliberate choice (ADR-S00-02, needed
# for third-party iframe compatibility), so promoting 90004-2 would make this
# gate permanently red on correct code. Revisit once that issue is fixed
